profile_text.body:
Xello describes itself as a K-12 college and career readiness platform that helps students build personalized pathways, supports educators with insights, and gives districts tools to strengthen future readiness at scale. The site addresses several audiences: district and school leaders, counseling and career advisor staff, CTE programs, teachers, students, and parents or family members. Students, teachers, and families sign in through login.xello.world using credentials provided by their district, and the company directs districts interested in the product to connect with a counselor or career advisor to arrange a demo.

The company is tracked for a product also named Xello, listed under education and research AI, with career matching as its AI function and career and college readiness for K-12 as its use. Its users are students and counselors, and student age access is tied to school accounts. Pricing is described as per-student by quote, with different tiers for elementary, middle, and high school, per a vendor statement on G2. The product note records that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and was not independently verified, and that privacy practices were not verified.

The name Xello (CASCAID) associates the platform with CASCAID. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or other registry facts are present in the available material.
